description: Defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for creating, updating, and responding with notes in the notes backend project.

classes.name: CreateNoteRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a new note, includes title and content with validation annotations.

classes.name: UpdateNoteRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating an existing note, includes title and content with validation annotations.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: DTO for responding with note details, includes id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt.
